# @three-ws/mcp-bridge

> MCP stdio bridge that turns any x402-paid HTTP endpoint into a Claude-callable tool. Auto-pays via the @x402 client (EVM exact, SVM exact, EVM batch-settlement) and pre-loads tools from the Coinbase x402 Bazaar.

@three-ws/mcp-bridge is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/mcp-bridge`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/x402-bridge/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/x402-bridge/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/x402-bridge/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/x402-bridge/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
